verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line noting that YAML-based agent configuration lets you 'version control your agent settings' (crewai-docs-24), which implies relying on external git rather than any built-in review/rollback workflow. There is no documented in-product versioning history, diff/review UI, or rollback mechanism for crews, tasks, or flows anywhere in the docs or enterprise feature list. Missing for 10: native version history for crews/flows, an in-app review/approval workflow, and a documented rollback feature.
